headlines.description: — Rookie Keyonte George scored a season-high 19 points to lead the Utah Jazz to a 114-112 victory over the New Orleans Pelicans on Monday night and a sweep of their two-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie George scores season-high 19, Jazz edge Pelicans 114-112 to sweep two-game set

headlines.description: — The Denver Nuggets were undermanned, on the road and playing the second night of a back-to-back without Nikola Jokic.
headlines.shortLinkText: Former Clippers Jackson and Jordan carry Nuggets past Los Angeles 113-104 without Jokic

headlines.description: — Jaylen Brown scored 30 points, Jayson Tatum had 21 and the Boston Celtics routed the Chicago Bulls 124-97 on Tuesday night to advance to the quarterfinals of the NBA In-Season Tournament.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaylen Brown scores 30 points as Celtics pound Bulls 124-97 and advance in the In-Season Tournament

headlines.description: — Spencer Dinwiddie scored 23 points to lead the Brooklyn Nets to a 115-103 win over the Toronto Raptors on Tuesday night to win their third straight, but were knocked out of the NBA In-Season Tournament.
headlines.shortLinkText: Despite 115-103 win over Raptors, Nets knocked out of NBA In-Season Tournament

headlines.description: — Donovan Mitchell and the Cavaliers did everything in their power to stay in the NBA In-Season Tournament.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mitchell scores 40 as Cavaliers beat Hawks 128-105, but don't advance in NBA In-Season Tournament

headlines.description: — With the game on the line, the Milwaukee Bucks were just about perfect.
headlines.shortLinkText: Antetokounmpo, Lillard combine for 65, and Bucks earn quarterfinal berth by topping Heat 131-124

events.name: Charlotte Hornets at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — The New York Knicks were already making plans for a trip to Las Vegas after learning they had advanced to the quarterfinals of the NBA In-Season Tournament.
headlines.shortLinkText: Knicks rout Hornets, earn wild-card spot in East to advance in the In-Season Tournament

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Minnesota Timberwolves

headlines.description: — Rudy Gobert had 17 points, 16 rebounds and four blocks, reserve Troy Brown Jr. scored a season-high 17 points and the Minnesota Timberwolves withstood an <a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Timberwolves top Thunder 106-103 despite Edwards injury with big all-around game by Gobert

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic had 41 points, nine rebounds and nine assists, and the Dallas Mavericks prevented the Houston Rockets from advancing to the quarterfinals of the NBA In-Season Tournament with a 121-115 victory on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Doncic scores 41, Mavericks prevent Rockets from advancing with a 121-115 victory

events.name: Golden State Warriors at Sacramento Kings

headlines.description: — Erasing most of a 24-point deficit assured the Sacramento Kings of advancing in the In-Season Tournament. Malik Monk made sure they did it with a win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Monk's late basket leads the Kings past the Warriors 124-123 to win In-Season Tournament group

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at Detroit Pistons

headlines.description: — LeBron James, coming off a career-high 44-point loss at Philadelphia, and his Los Angeles Lakers teammates were very loose during pregame warmups.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lakers bounce back to rout Detroit, handing Pistons team-record 15th straight loss

headlines.description: — Franz Wagner scored a season-high 31 points, Jalen Suggs added a season-best 22 and the Orlando Magic rolled to their eighth straight victory, 139-120 over the Washington Wizards on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Magic beat Wizards 139-120 for their eighth straight win

headlines.description: — Scottie Barnes scored 12 of his 23 points in the fourth quarter, Pascal Siakam finished with 22 and the Toronto Raptors beat Phoenix 112-105 on Wednesday night to end the Suns’ winning streak at seven.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raptors end Suns' winning streak at 7, spoiling Kevin Durant's return

headlines.description: — Jaren Jackson Jr. had 20 points and six blocks, David Roddy added 19 points and the Memphis Grizzlies defeated the Utah Jazz 105-91 on Wednesday night for their first home win of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaren Jackson Jr. scores 20 as Grizzlies defeat Jazz 105-91 for their first home win this season

headlines.description: — Zion Williamson took advantage of Joel Embiid's absence and punished the Philadelphia 76ers in the paint.
headlines.shortLinkText: Williamson's 33 points on near-perfect shooting lift Pelicans past 76ers 124-114

headlines.description: — Nikola Jokic had 32 points, 15 assists and 10 rebounds, Michael Porter Jr. scored a season-high 30 points and the Denver Nuggets rolled past the Houston Rockets 134-124 on Wednesday night in Jamal Murray's return from a hamstring injury.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jokic's triple-double lifts Nuggets past Rockets 134-124 in Murray's return

headlines.description: — Kawhi Leonard had 34 points and seven assists, James Harden scored 26 and the Los Angeles Clippers overcame a big game by De’Aaron Fox to beat the Sacramento Kings 131-117 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Leonard and Harden combine for 60 points as Clippers top Kings, 131-117

events.name: Portland Trail Blazers at Cleveland Cavaliers

headlines.description: — Donovan Mitchell heard the boos directed at him and his teammates as the game slipped away in the fourth quarter.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cavaliers booed at home during 'worst' loss this season as Trail Blazers beat Cleveland 103-95

headlines.description: — Terry Rozier had 37 points and 13 assists, and the short-handed Charlotte Hornets beat the Brooklyn Nets 129-128 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rozier has 37 points and 13 assists, Hornets win 129-128 to snap Nets' three-game winning streak

headlines.description: — The last time Miami scored 45 points in a fourth quarter was 1989, long before Pat Riley arrived in South Florida, long before Erik Spoelstra arrived, long before most of the current Heat players were born.
headlines.shortLinkText: Butler scores 36, Heat get hot late to top Pacers 142-132 and snap a 3-game slide

events.name: Detroit Pistons at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — Jalen Brunson scored 42 points, Julius Randle had 29 points and 10 rebounds, and the New York Knicks sent the Detroit Pistons to their franchise-record 16th consecutive loss with a 118-112 victory Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brunson scores 42, Knicks send Pistons to franchise-record 16th straight loss

headlines.description: — Alex Caruso took the handoff from Nikola Vucevic at the top of the key and dribbled twice to his right before launching a fadeaway 3-pointer over Brook Lopez at the end of...
headlines.shortLinkText: Vucevic and White lead the way as Bulls beat Bucks 120-113 in OT

headlines.description: — Karl-Anthony Towns had 32 points and 11 rebounds, and the Minnesota Timberwolves weathered the absence of leading scorer Anthony Edwards to beat the Utah Jazz 101-90 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Karl-Anthony Towns helps T-wolves beat Jazz 101-90 with Edwards sidelined

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 33 points and the Oklahoma City Thunder beat LeBron James and the Los Angeles Lakers 133-110 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scores 33 as Thunder beat Lakers 133-110

events.name: Atlanta Hawks at San Antonio Spurs

headlines.description: — Trae Young was practically unstoppable in the fourth quarter, but his defensive stop made the biggest impact against the San Antonio Spurs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Young scores 45 as Hawks rally past Wembanyama, Sochan to hand Spurs 13th straight loss

events.name: LA Clippers at Golden State Warriors

headlines.description: — Klay Thompson's fourth-quarter flurry brought back memories of so many other scoring bursts on his impressive list of them.
headlines.shortLinkText: Curry, Thompson come up big down the stretch, Warriors hold off Clippers 120-114
